title: Vindicta + Haze: Assassinate on a slept target
question: Does one full-charge Assassinate always land in full on a Haze-slept target, and does the low-HP set-up add the bonus?
hypothesis: H1.1/H1.2: full-charge value (~151 at 14.4k) hits 5/5; with target under 50% the hit is ~473.

arms.name: low_hp
arms.notes: Haze shoots target to 45% before dagger

procedure: Vindicta fires within 1s of the sleep
Record hit, damage number, time to wake

decision.rule: SUPPORTS H1.2 if low_hp beats full_hp by >=10%; H1.1 needs 5/5 hits at predicted value +-5%

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
